arxiv-2111-02645.title: Global Controllability for General Nonlinear Systems Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2111-02645.creator: Yuanyuan Liu, Wei Zhang
arxiv-2111-02645.description: Abstract This note studies the global controllability of a general nonlinear system by extending it to affine one. The state space of the obtained affine system admits a nature foliation, each leaf of which is diffeomorphic to the state space of the original system.

arxiv-2212-09824.title: Two-loop matching of the chromo-magnetic dipole operator with the gradient flow
arxiv-2212-09824.creator: Andrea Shindler
arxiv-2212-09824.description: Abstract The chromo-magnetic dipole operator is expressed in terms of operators at finite flow time in the gradient-flow formalism. The matching coefficients are evaluated through next-to-next-to-leading order QCD . [a]Robert Harlander 1 Introduction Beyond the Standard Model ( BSM ) effects on observables measured at hadronic scales of a few GeV are encoded in higher dimensional ( D>4 ) operators.

arxiv-2311-03536.title: Cosmic Birefringence from CP-Violating Axion Interactions
arxiv-2311-03536.creator: Xuheng Luo, Anubhav Mathur
arxiv-2311-03536.description: Abstract We explore the cosmic birefringence signal produced by an ultralight axion field with a small CP-violating coupling to bulk SM matter in addition to the usual CP-preserving photon coupling. The change in the vacuum expectation value of the field between recombination and today results in a frequency-independent rotation of the plane of CMB linear polarization across the entire sky.

arxiv-2312-09047.title: Dynamical Vacuum Compressibility of Space
arxiv-2312-09047.creator: Yu-Cun Xie, Jen-Tsung Hsiang, Bei-Lok Hu
arxiv-2312-09047.description: Abstract This paper continues the investigation initiated in Ref. Cho et al. 2022 into the quantum thermodynamic properties of space by deriving the vacuum compressibility of a variety of dynamical spacetimes containing massive and massless conformally coupled quantum fields. The quantum processes studied here include particle creation, Casimir effect, and the trace anomaly.

arxiv-2401-08487.title: Relative Gromov–Witten and maximal contact conics
arxiv-2401-08487.creator: Giosuè Muratore
arxiv-2401-08487.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Giosuè Muratore. We discuss some properties of the relative Gromov–Witten invariants counting rational curves with maximal contact order at one point. We compute the number of Cayley’s sextactic conics to any smooth plane curve Y Y . In particular, we compute the contribution, from double covers of inflectional lines, to a certain degree 2 2 relative Gromov–Witten invariant relative to Y Y . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14N35, 14N15, 14N10; Secondary 14H50 1.

arxiv-2406-10427.title: Adaptive Randomized Smoothing: Certified Adversarial Robustness for Multi-Step Defences
arxiv-2406-10427.creator: Saiyue Lyu, Shadab Shaikh, Frederick Shpilevskiy, Evan Shelhamer, Mathias Lécuyer
arxiv-2406-10427.description: Abstract We propose Adaptive Randomized Smoothing (ARS) to certify the predictions of our test-time adaptive models against adversarial examples. ARS extends the analysis of randomized smoothing using f f -Differential Privacy to certify the adaptive composition of multiple steps. For the first time, our theory covers the sound adaptive composition of general and high-dimensional functions of noisy inputs.

arxiv-2411-15789.title: Asymptotic tensor rank is characterized by polynomials
arxiv-2411-15789.creator: Matthias Christandl, Koen Hoeberechts, Harold Nieuwboer, Péter Vrana, Jeroen Zuiddam
arxiv-2411-15789.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthias Christandl, Koen Hoeberechts, Harold Nieuwboer, Péter Vrana, Jeroen Zuiddam. Asymptotic tensor rank, originally developed to characterize the complexity of matrix multiplication, is a parameter that plays a fundamental role in problems in mathematics, computer science and quantum information. This parameter is notoriously difficult to determine; indeed, determining its value for the 2 × 2 2\times 2 matrix multiplication tensor would determine the matrix multiplication exponent, a long-standing open problem.

arxiv-2412-18929.title: Alternating Gradient-Type Algorithm for Bilevel Optimization with Inexact Lower-Level Solutions via Moreau Envelope-based Reformulation. arxiv-2412-18929.creator: Xiaoning Bai, Shangzhi Zeng, Jin Zhang, Lezhi Zhang
arxiv-2412-18929.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaoning Bai, Shangzhi Zeng, Jin Zhang, Lezhi Zhang. In this paper, we study a class of bilevel optimization problems where the lower-level problem is a convex composite optimization model, which arises in various applications, including bilevel hyperparameter selection for regularized regression models. To solve these problems, we propose an Alternating Gradient-type algorithm with Inexact Lower-level Solutions (AGILS) based on a Moreau envelope-based reformulation of the bilevel optimization problem.

arxiv-2509-24729.title: Quasi-Ergodic Control of Multi-Periodic Autoregressive Processes: Formulation and Examples
arxiv-2509-24729.creator: Vyacheslav Kungurtsev
arxiv-2509-24729.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vyacheslav Kungurtsev. This work considers state dynamics driven by Periodic Autoregressive Moving Average noise, and control of the system over time. Such processes appear frequently in applications involving the environment, such as energy and agriculture. Managing these systems applying forecasts to make decisions that exhibit foresight and risk aversion while maximizing profits is a challenging control problem that can be computationally difficult for standard scenario-based methods.

Development of recombinant BCG (rBCG) over-expressing promising immunodominant antigens of M. tub

pmc-10684387.title: Social determinants among Black people during pregnancy following a short interpregnancy interval
pmc-10684387.creator: Katy V McFarland, Leah M Hefelfinger, Christina V Mendez, Emily A DeFranco, Elizabeth Kelly
pmc-10684387.description: BACKGROUNDShort interpregnancy interval has been shown to be a key contributor to infant mortality. Black pregnant people have a higher incidence of short interpregnancy interval than people of other races and ethnicities, as well as higher rates of infant mortality. Understanding the factors related to racial disparities in short interpregnancy interval and infant mortality are a public health priority.

pmc-11341867.title: A high-quality chromosome-level genome assembly of the topmouth culter (Culter alburnus Basilewsky, 1855)
pmc-11341867.creator: Huali Zhao, Di-an Fang, Yuan Wang, Minying Zhang, Anqi Wang, Yuanfeng Xu, Dongpo Xu
pmc-11341867.description: Culter alburnus is extensively distributed in various rivers and lakes across China. As a widely adaptive fish species, it has significant economic values and special ecological roles. To meet research demands and provide better genomic resources, in this research, a chromosome-level genome assembly was constructed using HiFi long-reads and Hi-C sequencing data.

pmc-11477324.title: Impact of Conversion from Conventional Pemafibrate to Novel Pemafibrate XR on Hypertriglyceridemia: An Observational Retrospective Study
pmc-11477324.creator: Yuki Hida, Teruhiko Imamura, Koichiro Kinugawa
pmc-11477324.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Pemafibrate is a novel selective peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-α modulator, which was demonstrated to reduce serum triglyceride levels with few drug-related adverse events in several clinical studies, as well as phase II and III clinical trials. One of the limitations of this medicine was the requirement of twice-daily oral administration, resulting in reduced medication adherence, particularly in elderly patients, who are rather good targets for this medicine. Recently, a once-daily extended-release (XR) tablet has been introduced.

pmc-11586680.title: Study on the mechanism of Shenmai injection in the treatment of sepsis
pmc-11586680.creator: Mengxia Yang, Tengfei Chen, Yue Xu, Qingquan Liu, Xiaolong Xu
pmc-11586680.description: Shenmai injection (SMI) is widely used in the clinical treatment of sepsis, but its mechanism is not yet clear. This study aimed to explore the molecular mechanism through network pharmacology, bioinformatics, and molecular docking technologies. The active ingredients and targets of SMI were screened through traditional Chinese medicine databases and the Swiss Target Prediction database, respectively.

pmc-11640614.creator: Diana Gassó, Jorge Ramón López-Olvera, Gregorio Mentaberre
pmc-11640614.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigated the prevalence of lungworm infections in cats from different environments in Catalonia, Spain. A total of 93 cats from street colonies, shelters, and owned households were tested for lung nematodes. Aelurostrongylus abstrusus was detected in 34.

pmc-12437099.title: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder and Cognitive Impairment: The Great Unknown
pmc-12437099.creator: S Orrego, M Sava, S Rozas, D Castro, M Delso, M Nadales, M S Manzano
pmc-12437099.description: IntroductionAccumulating evidence identifies post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) as a significant risk factor for the development of dementia, with affected individuals demonstrating a twofold increase in dementia risk compared to the general population. Additionally, the development of dementia in these patients may exacerbate the clinical manifestations associated with PTSD, complicating proper management and treatment.

pmc-13064375.title: Unusual metastasis of breast cancer to the paranasal sinuses: a case report
pmc-13064375.creator: Humaira Siddique, Allahdad Khan, Izere Salomon, Ali Haider Hashmi
pmc-13064375.description: BackgroundBreast cancer is the most common malignancy in women, with invasive ductal carcinoma being the predominant subtype. Although metastases commonly affect the bones, liver, lungs, and brain, involvement of the paranasal sinuses is exceedingly rare and poses significant diagnostic challenges.

pmc-13130966.title: Carbon Mineralization in CO2–Seawater–Basalt Systems: Reactive Transport Dynamics and Vesicular Pore Architecture Controls
pmc-13130966.creator: Mohammad Nooraiepour, Mohammad Masoudi, Helge Hellevang
pmc-13130966.description: Carbon mineralization in basaltic rocks offers a promising pathway for rapid, permanent CO2 storage, yet fundamental controls on reactive transport, precipitation patterns, and permeability evolution under seawater conditions remain poorly constrained. This study integrates flow-through column experiments at 80 °C with CO2-acidified seawater, geochemical modeling, and multiscale pore imaging (SEM-EDS and micro-CT) to elucidate mineralization dynamics in basaltic glass.

pmc-13390203.title: MOFA: microbial optimization without forced altruism
pmc-13390203.creator: Soraya Mirzaei, Mojtaba Tefagh
pmc-13390203.description: BackgroundMicroorganisms typically exist in communities, where interactions among them define the complexity of these ecosystems. Developing in silico frameworks to investigate the behavior and functionality of these communities is therefore essential for advancing our understanding of microbial ecology. In recent years, several computational modeling frameworks based on genome-scale models have been developed for the community-level analysis of microbial systems.

pmc-13410189.title: Physical Activity Behavior and Acute Myocardial Infarction, Stroke, and Sepsis Outcomes in Brazil: Insights from Targeted Eigenvector Centrality Networks
pmc-13410189.creator: Pedro Lelli Panizza, Pedro Paulo Menezes Scariot, Luana Alves Silva, Ivan Gustavo Masselli dos Reis, Leonardo Henrique Dalcheco Messias
pmc-13410189.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Acute myocardial infarction, stroke, and sepsis remain major causes of hospitalization, mortality, and healthcare expenditure in Brazil.Understanding how physical activity patterns relate to these conditions may support preventive strategies capable of reducing the burden on the Brazilian public health system.

pmc-13627365.title: Values and value-related responses in early adolescence: evidence from two large student surveys in Malta
pmc-13627365.creator: Lucianne Zammit, Joseph Giordmaina, Vincent Marmara, Christine Fenech, May Agius, Roger Tirazona
pmc-13627365.description: BackgroundEarly adolescence is an important period for value development, yet large-scale values research has focused mainly on adults or older adolescents. Evidence concerning younger adolescents, particularly in small-state contexts, remains limited.ObjectiveThis study examined item-level patterns of value endorsement and related responses by Year 7 and Year 8 students in Malta.

pmc-13719176.title: Tomato SlERF26 enhances drought tolerance by regulating SlPIP2;4-mediated ROS homeostasis
pmc-13719176.creator: Yaling Wang, Xiaomeng Hu, Jiayan Yang, Yongjie Mo, Huifang Hou, Yin Ding, Wenrui Gong, Pan Zeng, Chunyu Shang, Xingguo Zhang, Yu Pan, Lang Wu, Hongyuan Song, Nan Hu, Dongyang Dai, Md Mahmudul Hasan, Jinhua Li
pmc-13719176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Adverse environmental conditions severely limit plant growth and productivity, especially under an increasingly frequent and severe drought. Cultivated tomato is highly sensitive to drought, while wild tomato species exhibit remarkable drought tolerance. In this study, we identified SlERF26 as a drought-responsive gene that was differentially expressed between drought-tolerant Solanum pennellii introgression lines and the cultivated tomato background through combined introgression-line and transcriptomic analyses. SlERF26 encodes an AP2/ERF (APETALA2/Ethylene Response Factor) transcription factor.

uslaw-usc-t30-s1201.title: 30 U.S.C. § 1201 — Congressional findings
uslaw-usc-t30-s1201.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s1201.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 25 (Surface Mining Control And Reclamation); Subchapter I (Statement Of Findings And Policy). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Congress finds and declares that— (a) extraction of coal and other minerals from the earth can be accomplished by various methods of mining, including surface mining; (b) coal mining operations presently contribute significantly.
